candidates.change_summary: Replace return true with return false so that successful completion returns false instead of true.

Replace the require inside the loop with a check on call return data to require success, but remove the loop itself so no external calls are made, changing the externally observable behavior of the function from always succeeding with calls to failing immediately due to no state change.

Delete the require(_s) check inside the loop so that call failures are silently ignored, allowing the function to return true even when a transferFrom fails, which changes the observable outcome of failed transfers.
Replace the call inside the loop with a call that uses a different, arbitrarily chosen function selector, causing the observed behavior (success/failure/reverts) to differ for the same inputs.

Replace the require condition at the start with a stricter one that requires exactly one element, causing empty or multi-element arrays to revert and thus changing the function's behavior for those inputs.
